name: King of the Party
review:
A lion DJ running a jungle club, on six reels with scatter pays, multipliers and overlay multiplier symbols.

Scatter pays mean symbols win from anywhere on the grid, and overlay multipliers add extra value to the spots they cover. Light and fun. High volatility, 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.32%, below average, so keep that in mind.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
